note: Top toolbar action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for file operations (e.g., New, Open, Save, Close)
View mode toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary (e.g., List, Icon)
Toolbar status/label text -- renders fixed operator vocabulary (e.g., 'Ready', 'Select All')
File list column headers -- renders fixed operator vocabulary (e.g., Name, Size, Type, Modified)
Bottom action bar buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for archive operations (e.g., Extract, Add, Test, Delete)
Bottom action bar radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for extraction options (e.g., 'Extract to', 'Current folder')
Bottom action bar checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for options (e.g., 'Overwrite')
